name: GD Auto Clipper
description: Automatically records, saves, and clips your Personal Bests, StartPos runs, and level completions directly through OBS Studio!

obs-port.name: OBS WebSocket Port
obs-port.description: Port configured in OBS Tools -> WebSocket Server Settings (Default: 4455)

obs-password.name: OBS WebSocket Password
obs-password.description: Password set in OBS WebSocket settings (leave empty if none)

recording-mode.name: Recording Strategy
recording-mode.description: Continuous: records continuously during play. Replay Buffer: saves the last N seconds on death.

auto-save-pbs.name: Auto-Save Full Run PBs
auto-save-pbs.description: Automatically saves clips when you achieve a new personal best from 0%.

min-floor-percent.name: Minimum Floor %
min-floor-percent.description: Always save runs that pass this percentage, even if they aren't new PBs.

startpos-min-gain.name: StartPos Minimum Gain %
startpos-min-gain.description: Minimum percentage gained from a StartPos to trigger an automatic clip save.

startpos-save-pbs.name: Save StartPos Records
startpos-save-pbs.description: Automatically saves when you reach a new best percentage from that specific StartPos.

padding-tail-sec.name: Post-Death Reaction Padding (Seconds)
padding-tail-sec.description: How many seconds to keep recording after dying or beating a level to capture your reaction and audio fadeout.

padding-front-sec.name: Pre-Run Front Padding (Seconds)
padding-front-sec.description: Seconds of padding to include before the run starts.

allow-pause-recording.name: Allow Pause During Runs
allow-pause-recording.description: Keeps recording active while the game is paused (for nerve control / breathers).

max-pause-duration-sec.name: Max Pause Duration (Seconds)
max-pause-duration-sec.description: If paused longer than this, the clip is aborted to prevent huge file sizes.
